_meta.description: Dated ground photos, by the owner or by people who gave permission to use them. All entries now are stills from InfraUnfiltered's Line 6 ground report of 8 Aug 2026 (GKJLENdWdYA), shared with permission (owner, 2026-10-16 for drone videos and 2026-11-10 for ground videos; this video shared by the owner on 2026-11-11). The video mixes drone shots (kind "drone") and walks through the stations (kind "video"). Each still is matched to its station by the creator's on-screen station label or, for SEEPZ Village, by the station the creator names at that moment; 'date' is the day the video was published, video_t is the second in the video, and source_url opens the video there. 'pairs' are before/after pairs shown under the satellite comparison. 'stations' holds photos for each station page, keyed by the station id in stations.json. Put the image files in public/photos/ (location data removed) and add entries below. See UPDATING.md.

swami-samarth-nagar.alt: Ground view on the platform deck of Swami Samarth Nagar station under the steel roof frame, with puddles on the deck and housing blocks on both sides; the creator's label names the station
swami-samarth-nagar.caption: On the platform under the roof frame. The creator says the finishing work is moving fast

adarsh-nagar.alt: Ground view along the track bed at Adarsh Nagar station, with rail pieces laid out and the first roof poles up, between glass towers; the creator's labels name the station and say roof pole work has started
adarsh-nagar.caption: Roof poles going up over the track bed. The creator calls it one of the most advanced stations on the line

jogeshwari-west.alt: Drone view of the viaduct and the Jogeshwari (W) station structure between housing blocks, with work sites on the ground below; the creator's label names the station
jogeshwari-west.caption: The station structure among housing blocks. The creator says the main structural work is still going on here

jvlr.alt: Drone view along the double viaduct towards the JVLR station site at the junction on the Jogeshwari-Vikhroli Link Road, where the creator's label marks Metro Line 7 crossing
jvlr.caption: The deck near the junction with Line 7, an interchange. The creator says the station's civil structure is done and the roofing is next

shyam-nagar.alt: Drone view along the viaduct with track laid and a yellow track machine on it, over low housing; the creator's label names Shyam Nagar station
shyam-nagar.caption: Track laying on the viaduct at the station. The creator says the station is still waiting for its roof

mahakali-caves.alt: Drone view along the tracks into Mahakali Caves station, with its arched roof frame, green hills and a work site beside it; the creator's label names the station
mahakali-caves.caption: The tracks into the station, with the hills behind. The creator says it is a little ahead of Shyam Nagar

seepz-village.alt: Ground view inside the SEEPZ Village station concourse, with pipes, roof sheets and floor slabs stacked on the floor and green netting along the edge
seepz-village.caption: Materials stacked in the concourse. The creator says architectural finishing is going on

saki-vihar-road.alt: Drone view over traffic on Saki Vihar Road, with a column and the station under construction between the trees; the creator's label names the station
saki-vihar-road.caption: The station site over the road traffic. The creator says construction here is still going on

rambaug.alt: Drone view along the viaduct into Rambaug station and its curved steel roof frame, with stairs on the left and housing towers on the right
rambaug.caption: The station's roof frame beside new towers. The creator says the roofing is in progress

powai-lake.alt: Drone view of the viaduct and Powai Lake station beside the lake and its water hyacinth, with towers behind; the creator's label names the station
powai-lake.caption: The station beside the lake. The creator calls it one of the more advanced stations on the line

iit-powai.alt: Staircase being constructed by the wall of IIT - This is on the eastbound carriageway of JVLR. Work on this side commenced quite late compared to the staircase work on the other side.
iit-powai.caption: Staircase being constructed by the wall of IIT Powai Station

iit-powai.alt: Drone view along the tracks into IIT Powai station, under the steel arches of its roof frame; the creator's label names the station
iit-powai.caption: The tracks into the station under its roof frame. The creator says the roofing work is in progress

kanjur-marg-west.alt: Drone view of pier caps and deck under construction at the Kanjur Marg (W) station site, beside a playing field, with glass towers behind; the creator's label names the station Gandhi Nagar (Kanjurmarg)
kanjur-marg-west.caption: Deck work at the interchange site. The creator calls the station Gandhi Nagar and says it links to Line 4

vikhroli-eeh.alt: Drone view along the viaduct over the road to Vikhroli (EEH) station, with mangroves and open land around it; the creator's label names the station
vikhroli-eeh.caption: The viaduct to the last station on the line, with the mangroves around it

photos.alt: Cage Pier erected near Kanjurmarg ROB
photos.caption: Cage Pier erected near Kanjurmarg ROB
